basic_info.description: Welcome to Bayview Heights, This 4 bedroom and 3-bath beautiful home features high ceilings, hard wood floors and execptional natural light throughtout. The upper main house has 3BD/2BA, formal dinning rooms and living room with fireplace. Permitted Lower level has 1BD/1BD and living/dinning area.  Separate entrance ensures the convenience and privacy for all occupant. you'll find a private backyard perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Easy access to freeway, public transportation, close to schools, shops restaurants and parks.
